commits.subject: Make sidebar file preview errors easier to act on (#62362)
commits.reason: Show the attempted filename and a recovery hint when a sidebar preview fails. Strip the server’s diagnostic payload before a typed error reaches the TUI.
evidence: The unchanged upstream patch applies to all seven files in the combined source. Existing ALab event dispatch and retained sidebar handling stay in place. ALab-owned code has no additional constructor that expects the old string error type.

Only fs/readFile server errors receive file-specific classifications. The upstream regression sends a private diagnostic marker in the RPC payload and requires the typed error to preserve the public message while discarding the payload. The narrow-pane case keeps the filename visible and wraps the directory separately.
The native UI campaign targets these cases alongside the fork’s historical saved-layout decoder, covering the sidebar and retained session surfaces in the same compiled test binary.
